headline: Aniimo: the free creature-catcher everyone is playing
title: What Is Aniimo | Free Creature Catching Open World RPG | Gaming News
video_script: Have you tried Aniimo yet? Aniimo is a free to play, creature catching open world RPG from Pawprint Studio. It launched in September twenty twenty six on PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series, with mobile following a week later. Explore the huge continent of Idyll, catch over two hundred Aniimo with Aniipods, and watch new ones appear based on weather, biome and time of day. Most Aniimo can even evolve. Would you play this over Palworld? Comment below!
